openTicket.heading: Open a ticket
openTicket.intro: Report a fault on a bike. It leaves service so that no guest can book it, and the ticket must be resolved within 24 hours.
openTicket.vehicleCodeHint: As written on the bike, for example EB-701.
openTicket.inMaintenance: The bike is in maintenance until it is repaired.
openTicket.pending: The bike is on a trip: it moves to maintenance when the trip ends.

errors.vehicleCode: Enter the code of the bike.
errors.description: Describe the fault in up to 500 characters.
errors.invalid: Check the fields of the ticket.
errors.retired: This bike is retired, so it cannot get a ticket.
errors.unexpected: The ticket could not be opened. Try again.
